scope: Conceptual usefulness, algebraic sign, capacity, data-flow and evidence-scope review. Only these four new files were read; no model, tensor, QA, optimizer, GPU, F1 or bootstrap execution. No independent comprehensive literature audit or original gate/source re-execution.
accepted_points: Recomputing the current full decoder on preserved seen-FIT inputs avoids claiming that stale internal layer coordinates remain current. It directly measures teacher-forced answer NLL on those anchors, not generation F1 or general protection.

With a zero A and finite nonzero B, the new residual is initially zero. The first-step A gradient may be nonzero while the first-step B gradient is zero. Training the temporary factors can introduce directions absent from the frozen compact F/G.

A thin factorization of F G^T + A B^T has rank at most r+b. Retaining exactly r components per layer fixes the allocated final factor count; it does not imply numerical rank exactly r or bound approximation/forgetting error.

At z=1, deleting one scalar gate has first-order loss change -g. The response candidate must keep the largest -g deletion costs, without absolute values; simultaneous deletions remain only a first-order proposal. The subsequent full-candidate evaluations are necessary to select between the two proposed structures, not to prove global optimality.
Both masks in one flow and stage share that flow-specific decomposed parent. Complete flows can have different parents after their first different choice, as the document explicitly states.

The 19 recorded feature payloads support only the stated sample-wise payload range and separate-entry total. They are not an actual deduplicated bank, all-FIT distribution, full memory peak or final-model reduction. A 32 MiB bank is an untested cost point.

The final weight budget includes the full fixed visual/text/projector components and compact factors; no original dense residual or inference-time anchor bank may be omitted. Temporary expansion, optimizer state, SVD and LRU/anchor union costs remain separate training costs.
necessary_text_clarification: Specify descending ordering explicitly: retain the r components with largest -g. Negative scores are permitted and are not converted to absolute importance.

An index-free bounded online bank must be described by its actual online rule. It cannot promise recovery of the minimum-hash QA among all historical samples of an evicted/rejected group after that information has been discarded.
minimum_items_to_freeze_before_any_model: Selected physical replacement matrices, fixed per-layer ranks and final B below the common complete-model anchor; exact common initial compact model and its permitted initialization/recovery data schedule. No future-stage statistics or full-TRAIN teacher may enter it.

Temporary per-layer b and aggregate expansion limit, A/B initialization and scaling, factor packing/dtypes, LR/optimizer/reset rules, current-FIT update budget, and a total hard cost/time exit for both complete flows.

Anchor hash/scene-group identity, byte ledger and deduplication, rejection/eviction semantics, timing of current-stage admission into the historical bank, and fixed current-calibration sample/token limits. Empty-history and empty-calibration cases must be explicit.

Original TRAIN token/mask/position/attention semantics, QA-mean NLL aggregation and current/history weights, exact two candidate construction/sorting/tie rules, and the meaning of the decomposed parent under finite precision.

Full-flow comparison primary quality criterion and acceptable quality/cost exit, reporting all domains and explored-DEV status; unequal added anchor exposure/gradient/evaluation cost must not be called equal compute. No automatic full confirmation or third mechanism.
main_unresolved_risks: Common initial compression may already remove useful pretrained function; post-task rank renewal cannot be assumed to repair it.

The same repeatedly reused small bank supplies gradient proposals and selects candidates, so anchor overfitting and domain/group undercoverage are expected risks. Lower chosen-anchor NLL is a consequence of the rule and not a scientific success result.

Stable-feature caching requires the entire producer, preprocessing, image packing, embeddings and semantic metadata to remain compatible. It is optional engineering, not a source of new functional protection or free storage.
Temporary factor-only training and truncation may fail to learn new tasks or retain old ones. Fixed stored coefficient counts do not establish useful function capacity or quality retention.

Without matched added computation, two complete flows support a quality-versus-cost comparison of full procedures, not a pure superiority claim for the proxy. They do not compare against the unimplemented FD/local-response candidate.
novelty_assessment: Expand/train/truncate, latent replay, gradient-based component scores, and supervised finite-candidate selection are known ideas. The present candidate is sufficiently explicit to define a useful falsifiable question, but naming their combination does not establish a novel framework. The declared prior-work list is not an exhaustiveness certificate.
